interpretation: The plant-only two-mode reduction itself passed small-signal parity, so modal identification failure is not supported by the audit.
The source controller assumes direct thrust-vector synthesis and 100 Hz execution on a point load; V8 fairly restricted it to a rate-limited 20 Hz acceleration outer loop and a common inner loop.
The inherited benchmark uses discontinuous task setpoints and five massive internal links, whereas the source stability argument assumes a C5 desired load trajectory and a single inextensible cable.
Across the complete frozen budget, the adapted direction/angular cascade frequently saturated the common authority and produced unsafe attitude, height, and joint excursions.
The fast acquisition number is based on one successful sample and is not evidence of an Advanced baseline.
